key_points: Second wave of North America store closures (~250 stores) signals restructuring and cost cuts
Closures represent ~1% of total store base, modest scale but may pressure near‑term sales
COO emphasizes “Back to Starbucks” revamp and digital menu rollout to boost profitability
Long‑term impact unclear; execution of turnaround could be positive but short‑term sentiment negative
No earnings surprise or guidance change; news largely operational and likely short‑term price driver
